item.title: People Power Party Clash Again at Supreme Council Meeting… Woo Jae-joon Suggests ‘Full Resignation of Leadership Before Autumn’ vs. Pro-Power Faction: ‘Alien Language’ (국힘, 최고위 또 충돌…우재준 “가을 전에 지도부 총사퇴” 당권파 “외계어”)
item.description:
People Power Party Clash Again at Supreme Council Meeting… Woo Jae-joon Suggests ‘Full Resignation of Leadership Before Autumn’ vs. Pro-Power Faction: ‘Alien Language’ (국힘, 최고위 또 충돌…우재준 “가을 전에 지도부 총사퇴” 당권파 “외계어”)

At the People Power Party’s Supreme Council meeting held on the 18th, another clash erupted over the status of Representative Jang Dong-hyuk. Woo Jae-joon, a non-mainstream Supreme Council member, brought up the idea of a ‘full resignation before autumn,’ while Jo Gwang-han, a member aligned with the party’s power faction, remarked, “Once they grab the microphone, many start speaking in alien language.” (18일 열린 국민의힘 최고위원 회의에서 장동혁 대표의 거취를 놓고 또다시 충돌이 빚어졌다. 당내 비주류인 우재준 최고위원은 “가을 전 총사퇴”를 거론했고 당권파인 조광한 최고위원은 “마이크만 잡으면 외계어를 하시는 분이 많다”고 했다.)

Woo attended the party’s Supreme Council meeting at the National Assembly in Yeouido, Seoul, and stated, “I hope our leadership will conclude its term at least before autumn, by the time the situation with the National Election Commission is resolved.” This comes a week after he proposed a full resignation of the leadership on the 11th, saying, “Our leadership must not avoid evaluating and taking responsibility for the election results,” reigniting the resignation debate. (우 최고위원은 이날 서울 여의도 국회에서 열린 당 최고위원회의에 참석해 “우리 지도부가 중앙선거관리위원회 사태가 마무리되는 때에 적어도 가을 전에는 임기를 종료하는 것으로 했으면 좋겠다”고 했다. 지난 11일 “우리 지도부는 지금 선거 결과에 대한 평가와 책임을 회피하지 말아야 한다”며 지도부 총사퇴를 제안한 데 이어 1주일 만에 또 사퇴론을 꺼낸 것이다.)

He added, “I still hold the same view that the leadership’s role has ended with the conclusion of the local elections, that we should pave the way for the next leadership, and that if necessary, we should run in a party convention to be assessed. However, separately, I also agree that the issue of the Election Commission’s voting rights is a very serious matter that requires a strong response,” as he proposed the full resignation plan for autumn. (그는 “지방선거 종료와 함께 우리 지도부의 역할이 다했다는 점, 다음 지도부를 위해 길을 열어줘야 한다는 점, 필요하다면 전당대회에 출마해 평가를 받아야 한다는 점에 대해서는 여전히 생각이 같다”면서도 “이와 별개로 선관위 참정권 문제는 매우 중요한 사태이고 강력히 대응해야 한다는 점도 공감한다”며 가을 총 사퇴론을 제안했다.)

Regarding the controversy over his absence from the Supreme Council meeting on the 15th due to a business trip, Woo explained, “I attended an event in Thailand this week with key executives from NSF and others, delivering personal letters from the Minister of Environment and the Mayor of Daegu. Since it wasn’t an official schedule of the National Assembly, I covered all expenses with my own money.” He then brought up the leadership’s visit to the U.S., saying, “During the last local election period, our leadership went to the U.S., but few people know at what cost and for what purpose,” referring to Jang Dong-hyuk’s leadership trip to America. (우 최고위원은 지난 15일 최고위에 출장을 이유로 불참했다는 논란과 관련해서는 “이번 주 태국에서 NSF 주요 경영진 등이 참석하는 행사에 참석해 환경부 장관과 대구시장의 친서를 전달했다”며 “국회의 공식 일정은 아니었기 때문에 모든 비용은 제 사비로 부담했다”고 했다. 그러면서 “지난 지방선거 기간 중 우리 지도부가 미국을 다녀왔는데, 어떤 비용으로 어떤 목적으로 갔는지 아직까지 아는 사람이 별로 없다”며 장동혁 지도부의 방미에 대해 거론했다.)

In response, Jo Gwang-han, a close associate of Representative Jang, remarked, “It’s shameful to grab the microphone because there are many who start speaking in alien language as soon as they do.” He added, “At this critical time when we are struggling to restore broken voting rights and rebuild the foundations of the electoral system, I call for deep reflection on the phenomenon of hearing dissonant voices that target internal strife rather than rallying together, shaking the leadership.” (그러자 장 대표와 가까운 조광한 최고위원은 “자꾸 우리 당이 마이크만 잡으면 외계어를 하시는 분들이 많아서 마이크 잡는 게 참 부끄럽다”고 했다. 그러면서 “무너진 참정권을 되찾고 선거 제도의 기본을 다시 세우기 위해 힘겹게 투쟁하고 있는 엄중한 시기에, 모두가 힘을 모으기는커녕 내부를 향해 화살을 겨누며 지도부를 흔드는 파음이 들려오는 현상에 대해 깊은 성찰을 요구한다”고 했다.)

Floor Leader Jeong Jeom-sik also issued a warning at the end of the meeting, saying, “The Supreme Council meeting is not a general assembly of lawmakers. The Supreme Council is, by definition, our party’s highest decision-making body,” cautioning against exposing party conflicts through it. He stressed, “This place should serve as a venue for the leadership to present refined opinions and to discuss curbing the rampage of the Lee Jae-myung administration and the Democratic Party. I earnestly urge our lawmakers to uphold the dignity of our party.” (정점식 원내대표도 회의 말미 추가 발언을 통해 “최고위원회의는 의원총회가 아니다. 최고위원회의는 말 그대로 우리 당의 최고 의사 결정 기구”라며 최고위를 통해 당의 갈등이 노출되는 것에 대해 경고했다. 그는 “이곳에서는 당 지도부의 정제된 의견이 나가고, 이재명 정권과 민주당의 폭주를 견제하는 논의의 장이 돼야 한다”며 ”우리 의원들께서 우리 당의 품격을 보여주시길 간곡히 당부드린다”고 했다.)

After the meeting went into closed session, it was reported that Representative Jang Dong-hyuk expressed dissatisfaction toward Woo Jae-joon. Senior Spokesperson Choi Bo-yoon told reporters after the meeting, “The party leader also expressed hope that Woo Jae-joon, as a young politician, would play a good role in our party. He urged that rather than having only internal criticisms appear in the media, it would be more meaningful if efforts were made to accept the special counsel law, which requires a life-or-death struggle.” (회의가 비공개로 전환된 뒤 장동혁 대표는 우 최고위원을 향해 불만을 드러낸 것으로 전해졌다. 최보윤 수석대변인은 최고위가 끝난 뒤 기자들과 만나 “당 대표께서도 청년 정치인으로서 저희 당에서 우재준이 좋은 역할을 해줬으면 좋겠다고 했다”며 “당 내부 비판에 대한 목소리만 언론에 나오는 것보다는 정말 목숨 걸고 투쟁해야 하는 특검법 수용을 위한 노력을 해준다면 의미 있는 목소리가 되지 않겠느냐는 당부의 말씀도 있었다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee Directly Explains Achievements of European Tour in Briefing on the 19th (李대통령, 19일 브리핑에서 유럽순방 성과 직접 설명)
item.description:
President Lee Directly Explains Achievements of European Tour in Briefing on the 19th (李대통령, 19일 브리핑에서 유럽순방 성과 직접 설명)

President Lee Jae-myung, who returned home on the 18th after completing his European tour, will directly explain the outcomes of the trip on the 19th. The presidential office announced that President Lee will hold a briefing in person at the Cheong Wa Dae Chuncheon Pavilion on the 19th at 2 p.m. This marks the first time President Lee has personally briefed on a tour after returning from one. (유럽 순방을 마치고 18일 귀국한 이재명 대통령이 19일 직접 순방 성과를 설명한다. 청와대는 이 대통령이 19일 오후 2시 청와대 춘추관에서 직접 브리핑을 할 예정이라고 밝혔다. 이 대통령이 순방을 다녀온 뒤 직접 관련 브리핑을 하는 것은 이번이 처음이다.)

President Lee began his European tour on the 9th, holding a summit meeting with Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever in Brussels and meeting with King Philippe of Belgium. He also visited the European Union (EU) headquarters in Brussels, held a summit with EU Council President António Costa, and announced a joint Korea-EU declaration. (이 대통령은 지난 9일 유럽 순방 일정을 시작해 벨기에 브뤼셀에서 바르트 더 베버르 벨기에 총리와 정상회담을 가졌고, 필립 벨기에 국왕도 면담했다. 브뤼셀에 있는 유럽연합(EU) 본부를 방문해 안토니우 코스타 EU 정상회의 상임의장 등과 정상회담을 갖고 한·EU 공동선언을 발표했다.)

From the 10th, he made a state visit to Italy, holding a summit with President Sergio Mattarella and also meeting with Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni. On the 14th and 15th, he officially visited the Vatican, delivering a speech at a special mass held at the Basilica of Saint Paul Outside the Walls and meeting with Pope Leo XIV. On the 16th and 17th, he attended the G7 summit in Évian-les-Bains, France. (10일부터는 이탈리아를 국빈 방문해 세르지오 마타렐라 대통령과 정상회담을 갖고, 조르자 멜로니 총리와도 회담했다. 14~15일엔 바티칸을 공식 방문해 ‘성 밖 성바오로 성당’에서 열린 특별미사에서 연설했고, 레오 14세 교황과 면담했다. 16일과 17일엔 프랑스 에비앙에서 열린 G7(7국) 정상회의에 참석했다.)

President Lee held a one-on-one meeting with the Pope without aides, and during the official dinner of the G7 summit, he sat next to President Trump for two hours, exchanging views on issues such as the inter-Korean problem, the U.S.-Korea alliance, trilateral cooperation among Korea, the U.S., and Japan, and Middle East issues. (이 대통령은 교황과 배석자 없이 단독 면담했고, G7 정상회의 공식 만찬에서는 트럼프 대통령의 옆자리에 앉아 2시간 동안 남북 문제, 한미동맹과 한미일 협력, 중동 문제 등에 대한 의견을 교환했다.)

A Cheong Wa Dae official stated, “The outcomes of the tour, including the talks and the resulting joint declaration, were very diverse. Among them were key schedules that the president handled alone without aides, such as the meeting with the Pope and the dinner with Trump. We judged that a direct briefing by the president would be the most effective way to explain the tour’s achievements, which is why we decided on a direct briefing.” (청와대 관계자는 “회담과 그에 따른 공동선언 등 순방 성과가 워낙 다양하고, 그중에는 교황 면담이나 트럼프와 만찬 등 대통령이 배석자 없이 혼자 소화한 주요 일정도 있었다”며 “대통령이 직접 브리핑하는 것이 순방 성과를 설명하기에 가장 효과적이라 판단했기에 직접 브리핑을 결정한 것”이라고 전했다.)

item.title: Lee Jun-seok Issues Deep Apology Over Allegations That Jeong Yi-han’s Attack Was a Staged Incident (이준석, ‘정이한 후보 피습 자작극’ 의혹에 “깊이 사과”)
item.description:
Lee Jun-seok Issues Deep Apology Over Allegations That Jeong Yi-han’s Attack Was a Staged Incident (이준석, ‘정이한 후보 피습 자작극’ 의혹에 “깊이 사과”)

Lee Jun-seok, leader of the Reform Party, stated on the 18th regarding allegations that the attack on Reform Party Busan mayoral candidate Jeong Yi-han during a campaign rally for the June 3 local elections was a staged incident: “I offer a deep apology to the people and the citizens of Busan.” (개혁신당 이준석 대표가 18일 6·3 지방선거 당시 개혁신당 정이한 부산시장 후보가 선거 유세 도중 습격당한 사건이 자작극이었다는 의혹과 관련해 “국민 여러분, 부산 시민 여러분께 깊이 사과드린다”고 했다.)

During a party Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly that morning, Lee said, “It is hard to avoid a sense of shock and heavy-heartedness,” adding, “As he was a candidate nominated by the Reform Party, I feel an immense sense of responsibility for this matter.” (이준석 대표는 이날 오전 국회에서 열린 당 최고위원 회의에서 “참담하고 무거운 심정을 금하기 어렵다”면서 이같이 말했다. 그는 “개혁신당이 공천한 후보였기에 이 사안에 대해 무한한 책임감을 느낀다”고 했다.)

Lee remarked, “If the facts disclosed by investigative authorities and reported by the media are true, this is a serious election crime that is hard to even imagine,” and called it “an act that exploits voters’ trust and undermines the very foundation of democracy—the electoral system—something that can never be tolerated.” He added, “The Reform Party will actively cooperate with all procedures of the investigative authorities to leave not a single shred of doubt,” and “As already announced, we will launch a party fact-finding team to strictly hold former candidate Jeong Yi-han to the highest level of civil and criminal responsibility based on the facts that emerge.” <<> After the meeting, Lee told reporters, “(Former candidate Jeong) declared his retirement from politics on social media without notifying us, and someone who ran in a major election irresponsibly leaving the party online—these circumstances lead me to judge that there’s no choice but to hold him accountable.” He continued, “I do not think former candidate Jeong will be able to engage in political activities in the future,” and “This matter has clearly tarnished the party’s honor. We will take civil and criminal actions based on the decision of the party’s fact-finding team.” <<> Previously, on April 4, candidate Jeong Yi-han was struck by a beverage sprayed from a passing car during a campaign rally near Geumjeong-gu, Busan. He lost his balance, fell, hit his head on the ground, lost consciousness, and was taken to a hospital. At the time, police urgently arrested a man in his 30s on charges of the beverage attack. Jeong later submitted a plea for leniency for the man. <<> However, the Busan Geumjeong Police Station stated the previous day that they were investigating the possibility that Jeong had staged the incident with the man. Police are also known to have searched an office used as Jeong’s campaign headquarters on the 4th. Jeong has since left the Reform Party. (이 대표는 “수사기관이 공개하고 언론이 보도한 내용이 사실이라면 이는 상상하기조차 어려운 중대한 선거 범죄”라면서 “유권자의 신뢰를 악용하고 민주주의의 근간인 선거 제도 자체를 훼손하는 결코 용납될 수 없는 일”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “개혁신당은 한 치의 의혹도 남지 않도록 수사기관의 모든 절차에 적극적으로 협조하겠다”며 “이미 발표한 대로 당 자체 진상조사단을 가동해 드러나는 사실관계에 따라 정이한 전 후보에게 최고 강도의 민·형사상 책임을 엄정히 묻겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee Returns from European Tour… Jeong Cheong-rae’s ‘90-Degree Bow’ (이 대통령 유럽 순방 마치고 귀국… 정청래 ‘90도 폴더인사’)
item.description:
President Lee Returns from European Tour… Jeong Cheong-rae’s ‘90-Degree Bow’ (이 대통령 유럽 순방 마치고 귀국… 정청래 ‘90도 폴더인사’)

President Lee Jae-myung and First Lady Kim Hye-kyung returned home via Air Force One at Seongnam Seoul Airport on the morning of the 18th, concluding their first European tour. At the welcoming ceremony attended by government and ruling party leaders who came to share the trip’s achievements and greet the president, the angles of their bows drew attention. (이재명 대통령과 김혜경 여사가 18일 오전 첫 유럽 순방 일정을 마치고 공군 1호기 편으로 성남 서울공항을 통해 귀국했다. 순방 성과를 공유하고 대통령을 맞이하기 위해 나온 정부 및 여당 지도부와의 영접 현장에서는 인사 각도가 눈길을 끌었다.)

Air Force One arrived at Seoul Airport at approximately 11:34 a.m. that day. President Lee wore a navy suit with a tricolor striped tie, while First Lady Kim Hye-kyung was dressed in a white two-piece suit, descending the steps while linking arms with the president. (이날 오전 11시 34분경 공군 1호기가 서울공항에 도착했다. 이 대통령은 남색 정장에 삼색 사선 넥타이 차림이었고, 김혜경 여사는 흰색 투피스 정장 차림으로 이 대통령의 팔짱을 낀 채 트랩을 내려왔다.)

On the airport tarmac, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, Vice Minister of the Interior and Safety Kim Min-jae, Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae, floor leader Han Byung-do, chief of staff Kang Hoon-sik, senior political secretary Hong Ik-pyo, First Vice Foreign Minister Park Yoon-joo, and the commander of the Air Force’s 15th Special Mission Wing lined up to welcome President Lee. (공항 활주로에는 김민석 국무총리와 김민재 행정안전부 차관, 정청래 더불어민주당 대표, 한병도 원내대표, 강훈식 비서실장, 홍익표 정무수석, 박윤주 외교부 1차관, 공군 제15특수임무비행단장 등이 도열해 이 대통령을 맞이했다.)

President Lee shook hands one by one with the officials waiting below the steps. During this process, the angles of the attendees’ bows became a focal point. (이 대통령은 트랩 아래에서 대기 중이던 인사들과 순차적으로 악수를 나눴다. 이 과정에서 참석자들의 인사 각도가 이목을 집중시켰다.)

In particular, Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae, upon facing President Lee, deeply bowed nearly 90 degrees at the waist to show respect, and President Lee briefly said to him, “You’ve worked hard.” Prime Minister Kim Min-seok also bowed at about a 75-degree angle, but President Lee passed by without any additional remarks while shaking his hand. (특히 정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 이 대통령과 마주하자 허리를 90도 가까이 깊숙이 굽히며 예우를 갖췄고, 이 대통령은 정 대표에게 “수고했습니다”라는 짧은 인사를 건넸다. 김민석 국무총리 역시 75도 각도로 허리를 굽혀 인사했으나, 이 대통령은 김 총리와의 악수 과정에서는 별도의 언급 없이 지나쳤다.)

item.title: National Assembly passes parliamentary probe into election commission… 45-day investigation into ballot shortage (선관위 국정조사 국회 통과... 투표용지 부족 45일간 진상규명)
item.description:
National Assembly passes parliamentary probe into election commission… 45-day investigation into ballot shortage (선관위 국정조사 국회 통과... 투표용지 부족 45일간 진상규명)

The ruling and opposition parties passed a parliamentary investigation plan on the 18th at a plenary session of the National Assembly to look into the ballot paper shortage that occurred during the June 3 local elections. The motion was approved with 250 in favor and 1 against out of 251 lawmakers present. Independent lawmaker Choi Hyuk-jin was the sole dissenting vote. (여야는 18일 국회 본회의에서 6·3 지방선거에서 벌어진 투표용지 부족 사태를 조사하는 국정조사 계획서를 처리했다. 재석 251명 중 찬성 250명, 반대 1명으로 의결됐다. 무소속 최혁진 의원이 유일하게 반대표를 던졌다.)

The official title is the “Parliamentary Investigation for the Fact-Finding of Violations of Citizens' Suffrage Rights, Including the Ballot Paper Shortage in the 9th Nationwide Simultaneous Local Elections, and for Electoral Management Reform.” The investigation period spans 45 days from today until August 1, with the possibility of extension through a plenary vote if necessary. (정식 명칭은 ‘제9회 전국동시지방선거 투표용지 부족사태 등 국민참정권 침해 진상규명 및 선거관리 개혁을 위한 국정조사’다. 조사 기간은 이날부터 8월 1일까지 45일이고, 필요할 경우 본회의 의결로 활동 기간을 연장할 수 있게 했다.)

The target agencies under investigation include the National Election Commission and all levels of election commissions. Witnesses and reference persons will be determined by agreement between the ruling and opposition parties. Lawmaker Yoon Sang-hyun of the People Power Party will chair the committee, while lawmaker Yoon Gun-young of the Democratic Party of Korea and lawmaker Seo Beom-soo of the People Power Party will serve as secretaries. (조사 대상 기관은 중앙선거관리위원회 및 각급 선관위로 정리됐다. 증인 및 참고인은 여야 합의로 정해질 예정이다. 국민의힘 윤상현 의원이 위원장을 맡고 더불어민주당 윤건영 의원, 국민의힘 서범수 의원이 간사를 맡는다.)

The ruling and opposition parties also stipulated in the plan that the government and related agencies, organizations, corporations, and individuals cannot refuse to cooperate with the investigation or decline to submit materials on the grounds of criminal investigations or trials. (여야는 또 계획서에서 정부와 관련 기관·단체·법인·개인 등이 수사와 재판을 이유로 조사에 응하지 않거나 자료 제출을 거부할 수 없다고 명시했다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae Bows 90 Degrees to President Lee... "A World-Class Leader" (정청래, 李대통령에 90도 인사... 의총에선 “월드클래스 지도자”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae Bows 90 Degrees to President Lee... "A World-Class Leader" (정청래, 李대통령에 90도 인사... 의총에선 “월드클래스 지도자”)

Jung Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 18th, "Now is the time for the party, government, and presidential office to unite tightly and actively participate in President Lee Jae-myung's efforts for the settlement of peace and prosperity on the Korean Peninsula," adding, "Let's unite and work together in solidarity around President Lee Jae-myung to vigorously advance the clock of peace on the Korean Peninsula." (정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 18일 “당정청이 똘똘 뭉쳐서 한반도 평화 정착과 번영을 위한 이재명 대통령의 노력에 적극 동참해야 할 때”라며 “한반도 평화의 시계를 힘차게 돌려나갈 수 있도록 이재명 대통령을 중심으로 똘똘 뭉쳐 합심 단결 합심 노력하자”고 했다.)

Chairman Jung made these remarks during the party's general meeting of lawmakers held at the National Assembly, stating, "We must do everything we can at the National Assembly and party levels for the settlement of peace on the Korean Peninsula and the stability of state affairs." (정 대표는 이날 국회에서 열린 당 의원총회에서 “한반도 평화 정착과 국정 안정을 위하여 국회 차원에서 당 차원에서 할 수 있는 모든 일을 다해야 한다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

On this day, Chairman Jung attended a welcoming event for President Lee Jae-myung, who had returned from a European tour, and bowed his head to President Lee. President Lee greeted Chairman Jung by saying, "You've worked hard." (정 대표는 이날 유럽 순방을 마치고 돌아온 이재명 대통령 환영 행사에 참석해 이 대통령을 향해 고개를 숙였다. 이 대통령은 정 대표에게 “수고했습니다”라고 인사를 건넸다.)

At the lawmakers' general meeting, Chairman Jung said, "President Lee Jae-myung has just returned home after a successful European tour," and "President Lee's G7 European tour showcased the essence of national interest-centered, pragmatic diplomacy." He added, "Previous presidents made people anxious whenever they went abroad, but it seems that the public has high expectations for President Lee, wondering what new achievements he will bring back each time he goes on an overseas tour." (정 대표는 의원총회에서 “이재명 대통령께서 성공적인 유럽 순방을 마치고 방금 귀국하셨다”며 “이번 이 대통령의 G7 유럽 순방은 국익 중심, 실용 외교의 정수를 보여줬다”고 했다. 그는 “전임 대통령은 외국에 나갈 때마다 불안불안했었는데, 이 대통령은 외국 순방에 나갈 때마다 어떤 또 성과를 거두고 돌아오실까 국민들도 기대를 많이 하는 것 같다”고 했다.)

Chairman Jung stated, "In particular, securing the maximum tariff-free quota volume for the EU's new steel tariffs, which take effect from the 1st of next month, is a significant achievement that directly benefits our companies and citizens. Upgrading relations with Italy to a special strategic partnership, greatly expanding the scope of cooperation from high-tech industries to culture and tourism, is also an important accomplishment." (정 대표는 “특히 당장 다음 달 1일부터 적용되는 EU의 새로운 철강 관세에 대해 무관세 쿼터 물량을 최대한 확보한 것은 우리 기업과 국민에 직접적으로 도움이 되는 크나큰 성과”라며 “이탈리아와의 특별 전략적 동반자 관계로 격상하여 첨단 산업에서부터 문화 관광에 이르기까지 협력의 폭을 크게 넓힌 것도 중요한 성과”라고 했다.)

Regarding President Lee's conversation with U.S. President Donald Trump, he said, "That was the highlight of the highlights of this tour," describing it as "a moment that reaffirms the special friendship and deep trust between the leaders of South Korea and the U.S., and, as President Trump put it, a historic masterpiece in South Korean diplomatic history that fully displays the image of a strong leader." (또 이 대통령과 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 환담을 나눈 것에 대해 “이번 순방의 백미 중의 백미”라며 “한미 정상 간의 각별한 친분과 두터운 신뢰를 거듭 확인하는 자리이자 트럼프 대통령의 표현처럼 강한 지도자로서의 면모를 가감 없이 보여준 대한민국 외교사의 길이 남을 명장면이 아닐까”라고 했다.)

Chairman Jung continued, "I pay tribute and express gratitude for President Lee Jae-myung's unprecedented diplomatic achievements, which fully demonstrated the demeanor of a world-class political leader," and "I sincerely hope that the stalled U.S.-North Korea dialogue will resume, and inter-Korean relations will open new channels, leading to significant progress in the settlement of peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula." (정 대표는 그러면서 “월드 클래스 세계적인 정치 지도자로서의 풍모를 십분 발휘한 이재명 대통령의 역대급 외교 성과에 경의를 표하며 감사드린다”며 “멈춰선 북미 대화가 재개되고 남북 관계도 새로이 물꼬를 터서 한반도 평화 정착과 안정에 큰 진전이 있기를 간절히 소망한다”고 했다.)

item.description:
Party Leader’s Special Aide Chief: “Jang Dong-hyuk, allegations of election fraud? Language must be cautious” (당대표 특보단장 “장동혁, 부정선거 주장? 언어 신중해야”)

item.description:
Democratic Party staff also joined the National Election Commission's controversial "junket-style" overseas trips (선관위 ‘외유성’ 해외출장에 민주당 직원도 동행)

Amid controversy over the National Election Commission's overseas trips being criticized as junkets, it has been revealed that staff from the Democratic Party of Korea also accompanied some of these trips. <<> According to data on "overseas trips by National Election Commission staff over the past five years" submitted to People Power Party lawmaker Kim Ki-hyun on the 18th, two Democratic Party staff accompanied the commission's overseas trips in 2023. The stated reason was to check the overseas voting management system in preparation for the 22nd National Assembly election. <<> The data shows that one Democratic Party staff member joined the commission's trip to Osaka, Japan, for two nights and three days in August 2023. The expenses for three commission staff and one Democratic Party staff member amounted to approximately 7.3 million won. Around the same period, another Democratic Party staff member accompanied a trip to Siem Reap, Cambodia, for four nights and five days. The budget for four commission staff and one Democratic Party staff member's trip expenses was set at 15.4 million won. <<> Lawmaker Kim's office stated that both trips were conducted without even a review, as they were classified as official overseas trips for specific business purposes under relevant regulations. <<> Kim said, "It's equally problematic whether it's the Democratic Party, which blindly followed along on overseas trips funded by taxpayers' money, or the commission, which only brought along staff from a specific political party under the guise of system inspections." He added, "A full investigation should be conducted not only into the flawed elections but also into these 'flawed trips' that wasted taxpayers' money." <<> Earlier, on the 16th, the People Power Party's Media Special Committee and Media Legal Team announced they would file charges of embezzlement against National Election Commission officials suspected of taking junket-style trips to resorts like the Maldives. <<> At the time, the People Power Party's Media Special Committee cited media reports, pointing out, "Commission officials stayed four nights in Kota Kinabalu, Malaysia, where the number of voters was only about 120, and while the official task of checking overseas voting was completed in just half a day, the remaining schedule was left blank without even an itinerary," labeling it a junket trip. item.title: People Power Party Proposes Bill to Abolish Early Voting; Independent Han Dong-hoon Joins (국힘, 사전투표 폐지법 발의…무소속 한동훈 동참)
item.description:
People Power Party Proposes Bill to Abolish Early Voting; Independent Han Dong-hoon Joins (국힘, 사전투표 폐지법 발의…무소속 한동훈 동참)

On the 18th, Rep. Park Dae-chul of the People Power Party proposed a revision to the Public Official Election Act that would abolish early voting and extend the main voting period to two days. This marks the first time a bill to abolish the early voting system has been introduced. (국민의힘 박대출 의원이 18일 사전투표를 폐지하고 본투표를 이틀로 늘리는 내용의 공직선거법 개정안을 대표 발의했다. 사전투표제 폐지 법안이 발의된 것은 이번이 처음이다.)

Co-sponsors include 25 lawmakers, such as senior lawmakers in their third to fourth terms like Kim Sang-hoon, Yoon Young-seok, Kim Sung-won, Kim Jung-jae, and Song Eon-seok; party leadership including Supreme Council member Shin Dong-wook; and members of the "Alternative and Future" faction like Lee Man-hee and Kwon Young-jin. (공동 발의자로 김상훈·윤영석·김성원·김정재·송언석 의원 등 3~4선 중진 의원, 신동욱 최고위원 등 당 지도부, ‘대안과 미래’ 소속인 이만희·권영진 의원 등 25명의 의원이 참여했다.)

The amendment focuses on abolishing the early voting system and instead extending the main voting day from the current one day to two days. It also includes the reintroduction of an "absentee voting system," allowing voters who cannot participate in the main voting to vote in advance for two days starting four days before the election, provided they report this in advance. (개정안은 사전투표제를 폐지하는 대신, 본 투표일을 현행 하루에서 이틀로 늘리는 내용을 골자로 한다. 본투표에 참여하지 못하는 유권자는 사전에 신고한 경우 선거일 4일 전부터 이틀간 미리 투표할 수 있도록 하는 ‘부재자투표제’를 재도입하는 내용도 담겼다.)

Rep. Park stated on Facebook, "Under the current system, I am deeply concerned that not only early voting but even thorough election management itself may exceed the National Election Commission's operational capabilities. The fairness and credibility, which are the essence of elections, are being significantly compromised, and we can no longer leave this situation unattended. We must break this 'chain of distrust' that causes immense social costs and conflicts." (박 의원은 페이스북에 “지금 체제로는 사전투표는 물론이고 철저한 선거관리 자체가 선관위의 업무 역량을 넘어서는 것은 아닌지 매우 우려된다”며 “선거의 본질인 공정성과 신뢰성이 크게 훼손되는 상황을 더는 방치해선 안 된다. 극심한 사회적 비용과 갈등을 초래하는 이 ‘불신의 사슬’을 끊어내야 한다”고 했다.)

Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, who was expelled from the People Power Party, also joined this proposal. (이번 발의에는 국민의힘에서 제명된 무소속 한동훈 의원도 동참했다.)

item.title: [Breaking] Kim Yo-jong on G7 ‘Denuclearization’ Statement: “Nuclear Possession is Our Core Interest… Denuclearization Won’t Happen” ([속보] 北김여정, G7 ‘비핵화’ 성명에 “핵 보유는 우리 핵심 이익…비핵화 안 될 것”)
item.description:
[Breaking] Kim Yo-jong on G7 ‘Denuclearization’ Statement: “Nuclear Possession is Our Core Interest… Denuclearization Won’t Happen” ([속보] 北김여정, G7 ‘비핵화’ 성명에 “핵 보유는 우리 핵심 이익…비핵화 안 될 것”)

Kim Yo-jong, a department director of North Korea’s Workers’ Party, stated in response to the G7 leaders’ joint statement expressing concerns over North Korea’s nuclear and missile programs that “our nuclear weapons are permanent and unchangeable,” adding that “the G7 has no qualifications or rights to discuss our sovereign choices.” (김여정 북한 노동당 부장이 북핵·미사일에 대한 우려를 나타낸 G7(7국) 정상 공동성명에 대해 “우리 핵은 영구불변”이라며 “(G7은) 주권적 선택을 논할 자격이나 권리가 없다”고 밝혔다.)

In a statement released through the Korean Central News Agency on the 18th, Kim Yo-jong declared that “nuclear possession is our core interest” and “denuclearization won’t happen.” (김여정은 18일 조선중앙통신을 통해 내놓은 담화에서 “핵 보유는 우리 핵심 이익”이며 “비핵화는 안 될 것”이라며 이같이 밝혔다.)

Earlier, the G7 leaders had adopted a joint statement saying, “We express deep concern over North Korea’s nuclear and ballistic missile programs and reaffirm our commitment to achieving the complete denuclearization of North Korea in accordance with UN Security Council resolutions.” (앞서 G7 정상들은 “우리는 북한의 핵 및 탄도미사일 프로그램에 대해 깊은 우려를 표명하며 유엔 안전보장이사회 결의에 따라 북한의 완전한 비핵화를 실현하겠다는 우리 의지를 재확인한다”는 공동성명을 채택했다.)

item.title: S. Korea Skips G7 Declaration on Critical Mineral Supply Chains... Strategic Distance Amid China-Containment Sentiment (韓 G7 ‘핵심광물 공급망’ 선언 불참… 中 견제 기류 속 ‘전략적 거리두기’)
item.description:
S. Korea Skips G7 Declaration on Critical Mineral Supply Chains... Strategic Distance Amid China-Containment Sentiment (韓 G7 ‘핵심광물 공급망’ 선언 불참… 中 견제 기류 속 ‘전략적 거리두기’)

President Lee Jae-myung did not sign the "Stabilizing Critical Mineral Supply Chains" declaration adopted at the G7 summit held in Évian-les-Bains, France. Among the eight documents adopted at the G7 summit, he declined to sign the declaration on stabilizing critical mineral supply chains, while signing the remaining seven. Although the document does not explicitly mention China, it is widely seen as targeting China, which has effectively imposed export controls on rare earths. While G7 member states and Australia signed the document, South Korea, Brazil, India, Egypt, and Kenya did not. (이재명 대통령이 프랑스 에비앙에서 열린 G7 정상회의에서 채택된 ‘핵심 광물 공급망 안정화’ 선언문에 서명하지 않았다. G7 정상회의에서 채택된 문건 8건 가운데 ‘핵심 광물 공급망 안정화’ 선언문에 대해서는 서명에 불참한 것이다. 나머지 7건에는 서명했다. 해당 문건에는 중국이라는 표현은 없지만 사실상 희토류 수출 통제에 나선 중국을 겨냥한 것으로 평가된다. G7 회원국들과 호주가 해당 문건에 서명한 반면 한국과 브라질, 인도, 이집트, 케냐는 서명하지 않았다.)

The presidential office stated, "Although we did not participate in the declaration, we support the G7's efforts to diversify critical minerals and build resilient supply chains." The presidential office maintains that South Korea's situation differs from other countries, as it has already developed many alternative supply routes. However, some analysts suggest that the decision not to sign may have been influenced by concerns about China. (청와대는 “선언문에는 불참했으나 G7의 핵심 광물 다변화와 회복력 있는 공급망 구축 노력은 지지한다”고 밝혔다. 청와대 측은 한국의 경우 대체 공급선을 많이 개발해 다른 국가들과 상황이 다르다는 입장이지만 중국을 의식해 서명에 불참한 것 아니냐는 해석도 제기된다.)

This G7 declaration on "Stabilizing Critical Mineral Supply Chains" aims to reduce excessive dependence on specific countries in the production and processing of critical minerals, and to strengthen supply chain diversification and transparency. Diplomatic circles view this declaration as a starting signal for "building a China-free supply chain" targeting China. (이번 G7의 ‘핵심 광물 공급망 안정화’ 선언은 핵심 광물의 생산과 가공 분야에서 특정 국가에 대한 과도한 의존도를 낮추고, 공급망의 다변화 및 투명성을 강화하겠다는 내용을 담고 있다. 외교가에서는 이번 선언이 중국을 겨냥한 ‘탈중국 공급망 구축’의 신호탄이라고 보고 있다.)

South Korea currently relies heavily on Chinese minerals and materials in key industries such as secondary batteries and semiconductors. If the country had fully joined this declaration, it would have inevitably faced severe backlash from China, including trade retaliation measures, which likely factored into the decision. While the presidential office took a cautious stance, stating that it "supports the G7's efforts to diversify critical minerals and build resilient supply chains," it is widely assessed as a realistic diplomatic strategy that takes into account relations with China. (우리나라는 이차전지, 반도체 등 핵심 산업에서 중국산 광물 및 소재에 대한 의존도가 매우 높은 상황이다. 만약 이번 선언에 전면 동참할 경우 중국의 거센 반발과 무역 보복 조치 등 경제적 타격이 불가피하다는 판단이 작용했을 것으로 보인다. 청와대는 이번 불참에 대해 “핵심 광물 다변화와 회복력 있는 공급망 구축이라는 G7의 노력은 지지한다”며 신중한 입장을 보였으나, 사실상 대중국 관계를 고려한 현실적인 외교 전략이라는 평가가 지배적이다.)

item.title: “Need for Humanistic Leadership That Preserves Human Dignity” (“인간의 존엄 지키는 인본주의적 리더십 필요”)
item.description:
“About 100 years ago, Dosan spread the spirit of aegiaeta (loving oneself and loving others) to our divided compatriots for national unity. Aegiaeta is the spiritual foundation that Korean society needs now.” (Kang Seok-jin, Chairman of the Convergence Coexistence Forum) (“도산은 약 100년 전 분열된 우리 동포들에게 국민 화합을 위한 애기애타(愛己愛他) 정신을 전파했습니다. 애기애타는 지금 한국 사회에 필요한 정신적 근간입니다.” (강석진 융합상생포럼 이사장))

Senior figures from domestic academia and industry held a symposium on the theme of “Aegiaeta Leadership in the Age of AI (Artificial Intelligence)” at the National Assembly Library in Yeouido, Seoul, on the 17th. Aegiaeta is a leadership spirit emphasized by Dosan Ahn Chang-ho, meaning “Love others as you love yourself.” This event was hosted by the Convergence Coexistence Forum, a incorporated association, and Rep. Kang Seung-kyu of the People Power Party. Founded in 2016, the Convergence Coexistence Forum has held regular meetings on topics such as social integration, the Fourth Industrial Revolution, and technological advancement. <<> Chairman Kang Seok-jin stated, “Korea is an economically advanced country, but its political culture, which ranks in the lower tier globally, is severely dividing the people. I urge politicians to take the lead in advancing political culture with the spirit of aegiaeta.” Seo Sang-mok, a distinguished professor at Kangnam University and former Minister of Health and Welfare, cited situations of political leadership absence, such as two presidential impeachments, U.S.-China hegemonic competition, and Europe’s fragmentation, noting, “Policies or systems alone cannot resolve these situations.” Professor Seo explained the significance of the aegiaeta spirit, saying, “We need humanistic leadership that contemplates how to preserve human dignity.” <<> Former Gyeonggi Governor Kim Moon-soo said, “Following Dosan’s teachings, we must establish leadership that constantly reflects on oneself and loves others to that same extent.” Kim Jeon-seung, Chairman of the Heungsadan, emphasized aegiaeta leadership, stating, “Depending on how we respond to AI development, society can either advance or regress. People, not technology, must be at the center.” Sohn Wook, Chairman of the Sejong National Management Research Institute, linked the aegiaeta spirit to King Sejong’s minbonism (people-centered governance), which holds that “the people are the foundation of the nation,” and argued, “We must maximize human dignity to transform the Republic of Korea, which is mired in division and conflict.” (국내 학계·산업계 원로들이 17일 ‘AI(인공지능) 시대의 애기애타 리더십’ 을 주제로 서울 여의도 국회도서관에서 심포지엄을 열었다. 애기애타는 도산 안창호 선생이 강조한 리더십 정신으로 ‘나를 사랑하듯 남을 사랑하라’는 뜻이다. 이번 행사는 사단법인 융합상생포럼과 국민의힘 강승규 의원이 개최했다. 2016년 창립한 융합상생포럼은 사회 대통합, 4차 산업혁명, 기술 선진화 등을 주제로 정기 회의를 열어왔다.)

item.title: "Building an AI Cluster in Hanam to Become a City Jensen Huang Seeks Out" (“하남에 AI 클러스터 꾸려 젠슨 황이 찾는 도시 될 것”)
item.description:
The June 3 Hanam mayoral election was one of the most fiercely contested races among Gyeonggi Province's basic local government heads. Incumbent Mayor Lee Hyeon-jae (77) of the People Power Party won with 51.95% of the vote, defeating Democratic Party candidate Kang Byung-deok (48.04%) by a margin of 3.91 percentage points. This marks the first time a mayor affiliated with a People Power Party-aligned party has won re-election in Hanam. Mayor Lee served as the head of the Small and Medium Business Administration and a 19th and 20-term National Assembly member before being elected Hanam mayor in 2022. <<> On the 17th, I met Mayor Lee in his office at Hanam City Hall. His black suit paired with white sneakers caught my eye—a trademark that sparked buzz during the election. The left shoelace was blue, and the right one was red. <<> -How did you come to wear them? <<> "After first being elected Hanam mayor in 2022, I consistently wore red sneakers symbolizing the People Power Party. But some citizens said I was overemphasizing my political color. So this time, I started tying both red and blue shoelaces together. It means citizens' happiness comes before ideology or faction. It felt a bit awkward at first, but the public response was better than I expected, so I've kept wearing them." <<> -What do you think contributed to your re-election? <<> "I believe Hanam citizens carefully considered who would lead the city's development effectively, rather than being swayed by factional logic or party colors. There were many cases of split-ticket voting. Many citizens who voted for Democratic Party candidate Choo Mi-ae in the Gyeonggi Province governor election gave their votes to me in the Hanam mayoral race." <<> -How was the election process? <<> "The toughest part was the low approval rating for the People Power Party. When I met citizens, I heard many say, 'Lee Hyeon-jae does a good job, but I'm torn because of his party.' I had no choice but to meet more citizens. I visited every restaurant in every alley. I personally explained what I'd done over the past four years and how I plan to change Hanam going forward. With sincerity, even indifferent citizens started to listen." <<> -At 77 this year, you are the oldest among the basic local government heads elected in this local election. <<> "I make an effort to manage my fitness regularly. At home, I do push-ups, dumbbell exercises, and ride an indoor bike. Lately, I walk around city hall for 20-30 minutes a day. The secret to my stamina is thinking positively. I try not to hold onto stress for too long." <<> -What areas will you focus on investing in over the next four years? <<> "The economy. Hanam is a great city to live in, but its economic strength is weak. Ultimately, we need to attract businesses and create jobs. I am staking everything on building the Gyosan New Town AI (Artificial Intelligence) Innovation Cluster. It's a 3 trillion won project involving POSTECH, Carnegie Mellon University, the National University of Singapore, and KT Cloud. The goal is to make Hanam an AI industry city that global business figures like Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang or OpenAI CEO Sam Altman would want to visit. In Misadong, we plan to build 'K-Star World,' a complex for performances, entertainment, and MICE (exhibitions), as a K-Culture composite complex." <<> -How will K-Star World be promoted? <<> "K-Star World isn't just about building a single performance venue. It's about creating a cultural industry ecosystem that blends K-pop concert halls, film studios, and K-Culture businesses. We plan to develop a national garden on the Han River riverside near K-Star World to create synergy." (6·3 하남시장 선거는 경기도 기초단체장 선거 중 가장 치열한 승부가 벌어진 곳 중 하나다. 국민의힘 이현재(77) 시장이 득표율 51.95%로 더불어민주당 강병덕(48.04%) 후보를 3.91%포인트 차로 꺾었다. 하남에서 국민의힘 계열 정당 소속 시장이 재선에 성공한 것은 처음이다. 이 시장은 중소기업청장과 19·20대 국회의원 등을 거쳐 2022년 하남시장에 당선됐다.)

item.title: Special Counsel Law Hangs in the Balance… Rival Parties Clash Over Chair of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee (특검법 걸려있다… 여야, 법사위원장 자리 놓고 충돌)
item.description:
Although 20 days have passed since the start of the latter half of the National Assembly session, the ruling and opposition parties remain in a standoff over the formation of the Assembly. The key point of contention is which party will take the chair of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee. (후반기 국회가 시작된 지 20일이 지났지만 여야(與野)는 원(院) 구성 협상에서 대치를 이어가고 있다. 쟁점은 국회 법제사법위원장을 어느 쪽이 맡느냐는 것이다.)

The Legislation and Judiciary Committee serves as the "final gateway" for various bills. Among the pending contentious bills is the "Special Counsel on Fabricated Indictment Act," proposed by the Democratic Party. This bill unusually grants the special counsel the authority to withdraw indictments, which has led the opposition to claim that it aims to drop criminal charges against President Lee Jae-myung through the special counsel. (법사위는 각종 법안의 ‘최종 관문’ 역할을 하는데, 현재 대기 중인 대표적 쟁점 법안으로 민주당이 발의한 ‘조작 기소 특검법’이 있다. 이 법안은 조작 기소 특검에게 이례적으로 공소 취소 권한을 부여했고, 이 때문에 특검을 통해 이재명 대통령 형사사건의 공소를 취소하려 한다고 야권이 반발해 왔다.)

The People Power Party maintains that "to prevent the Democratic Party from forcing through the special counsel bill, the chair of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee cannot be given up." The Democratic Party has also stated that the chair of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee is non-negotiable. Democratic Party Floor Leader Han Byeong-do said during a general meeting of lawmakers on the 18th, "If we yield the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, we will become an incompetent ruling party that cannot get things done," adding, "We will proceed with negotiations unwaveringly, firmly adhering to the principle that the Democratic Party will secure the Legislation and Judiciary Committee." In a closed-door meeting, Han further remarked, "The opposition is blocking livelihood bills through filibusters, and if we lose the chair of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, the current government will be completely hamstrung." (국민의힘은 “민주당의 특검법 강행을 막기 위해서라도 법사위원장은 내줄 수 없다”는 입장이다. 민주당도 법사위원장은 양보할 수 없다고 했다. 한병도 민주당 원내대표는 18일 의원총회에서 “법사위를 양보하면 일을 못하는 무능한 여당이 될 것”이라며 “법사위는 민주당이 확실하게 가져온다는 원칙을 갖고 흔들림 없이 협상에 임하도록 하겠다”고 했다. 이어 한 원내대표는 비공개 회의에서도 “민생법안도 야당이 필리버스터(무제한 토론)로 막고 있는데 법사위원장까지 뺏기면 현 정부 발목 다 묶이는 것”이라고 했다.)

The Democratic Party plans to finalize the Assembly formation by next week. Democratic Party Spokesperson Lee Ju-hee stated, "After wrapping up the Assembly formation next week, a workshop for all Democratic Party lawmakers is scheduled for the 3rd of next month," adding, "We will discuss in detail the operations of the latter half of the National Assembly and activities following the formation." (민주당은 다음 주까지 원 구성을 마무리하겠다는 계획이다. 이주희 민주당 원내대변인은 “다음 주 원 구성을 마무리한 이후 다음 달 3일 민주당 전체 의원 워크숍이 개최될 예정”이라며 “하반기 국회 운영과 원 구성 이후 활동에 대해 구체적으로 논의할 것 같다”고 말했다.)

Observations within political circles suggest that "the Democratic Party will unilaterally push through the election of standing committee chairs." Since the chairs of standing committees are elected in the plenary session rather than within each committee, the Democratic Party, holding a majority of seats, could potentially occupy all 18 standing committee chairs through a unilateral vote. In fact, in 2020, when the then-ruling Democratic Party broke off negotiations with the Future Unity Party (now the People Power Party) over the Assembly formation, it unilaterally elected all 18 standing committee chairs in the plenary session and operated them for a year. This was the first such occurrence since democratization in 1987. (정치권에서는 “민주당이 상임위원장 선출을 단독으로 밀어붙일 것”이란 관측이 나온다. 국회 상임위원장은 각 상임위원회가 아닌 본회의에서 선출되기 때문에 다수 의석을 확보한 민주당이 단독 표결을 통해 18개 상임위원장을 독차지하는 것도 가능하다. 실제 2020년 당시 여당인 민주당은 미래통합당(현 국민의힘)과의 원 구성 협상이 결렬되자 국회 본회의에서 18개 상임위원장직을 단독 선출해 1년간 운영했다. 1987년 민주화 이후 처음이었다.)

People Power Party Floor Leader Jeong Jeom-sik said during a supreme council meeting that day, "Refusing to give up the chair of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee means they are refusing to give up forcing through the indictment withdrawal special counsel bill," and added, "If the Legislation and Judiciary Committee does not return to its proper place, normalizing the latter half of the National Assembly will be difficult, and the Lee Jae-myung administration's legislative push, led by the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, will continue." He further stated, "Returning the Legislation and Judiciary Committee to its proper place is the overarching premise for the Assembly formation negotiations." This was interpreted as meaning that if the People Power Party is not given the chair of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, the Assembly formation negotiations will not be concluded. (국민의힘 정점식 원내대표는 이날 최고위원회의에서 “법사위원장직을 포기하지 않겠다는 건 공소취소 특검법 강행 처리를 포기하지 않겠다는 뜻”이라며 “법사위가 제자리로 돌아오지 않는다면 후반기 국회 정상화는 난망하고, 법사위를 앞세운 이재명 정부의 입법 독주도 계속될 것”이라고 말했다. 그러면서 “법사위 제자리가 원 구성 협상의 대전제”라고 했다. 국민의힘에게 법사위원장을 주지 않는다면 원 구성 협상이 타결되지 않을 것이란 의미로 해석됐다.)

The People Power Party decided that day to expand and reorganize the "Special Committee to Block the Cancellation of President Lee Jae-myung's Trial" as a party special committee. Originally established under the Central Election Countermeasures Committee for the June 3 local elections and operated temporarily during the election period, it was converted into a party special committee to more actively respond to the issue of indictment withdrawal. Lawmaker Joo Jin-woo, a former prosecutor, will chair the committee, with its first meeting scheduled for the 22nd. (국민의힘은 이날 ‘이재명 대통령 재판취소 저지 특별위원회’를 당 특별위원회로 확대 개편하기로 했다. 해당 특위는 당초 6·3 지방선거 중앙선거대책위원회 산하에 설치돼 선거 기간 한시 운영됐으나, 공소취소 문제에 보다 적극적으로 대응하기 위해 당 특위로 전환됐다. 위원장은 검찰 출신인 주진우 의원이 맡았고 오는 22일 첫 회의를 열 예정이다.)

Democratic Party Leader Jeong Cheong-rae stated in March, "In forming the latter half of the Assembly, the principle is that the Democratic Party will take 100% responsibility for the standing committee chairs." However, the Democratic Party lost Seoul in the June 3 local elections, and given the recent decline in approval ratings, the political burden of "monopolizing standing committees" is not insignificant. (정청래 민주당 대표는 지난 3월 “후반기 원 구성에 있어서 상임위원장은 100% 민주당이 맡아서 책임을 지겠다는 원칙”이라고 했다. 하지만 민주당은 6·3 지방선거에서 서울에서 패배했고, 최근 지지율 하락을 감안하면 ‘상임위 독식’에 따른 정치적 부담도 적지 않은 상황이다.)

National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik, a former member of the Democratic Party, urged both parties to reach an agreement on the Assembly formation during his opening remarks at the plenary session that day. Speaker Woo said, "To fully restart the clock on all livelihood legislation, we must hasten the completion of the latter half's Assembly formation," adding, "There are about 140 bills that have passed through standing committees and are awaiting review by the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, and many bills are still awaiting review in standing committees." In May, immediately after being confirmed as a candidate for National Assembly Speaker, Woo had stated, "We will quickly complete the Assembly formation by June and handle all legislative tasks for state affairs by December." (민주당 출신인 조정식 국회의장은 이날 본회의 모두발언에서 여야에 원 구성 합의를 촉구했다. 조 의장은 “모든 민생 입법 시계를 온전히 가동하기 위해서는 후반기 원 구성을 서둘러 마무리해야 한다”며 “현재 상임위원회를 통과해 법제사법위원회 심사를 기다리는 법안이 140여 건이고, 상임위에서 법안 심사를 기다리는 법안도 많다”고 했다. 조 의장은 지난 5월 국회의장 후보로 확정된 직후 “6월 내에 원 구성을 신속히 완료하고, 12월 내 국정 과제 입법을 모두 처리하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Han Sung-sook’s Prime Minister Confirmation Hearing: No Witnesses or References Called – Blocked by Democratic Party Opposition (한성숙 총리 인사청문회, 증인도 참고인도 0명… 민주당 반대로 못 불러)
item.description:
The National Assembly confirmation hearing for Prime Minister nominee Han Sung-sook, scheduled for the 25th and 26th, is expected to proceed without any witnesses or references. Although the People Power Party (PPP) proposed 11 individuals as witnesses and references, the Democratic Party (DP) opposed the move. This marks the second time a prime minister confirmation hearing has been held without witnesses or references since last year’s hearing for Prime Minister Kim Min-seok. The PPP has criticized the DP, stating, “The ruling party is even blocking the opportunity to verify the qualifications and capabilities of the prime minister nominee.” Han, a former CEO of Naver, previously served as Minister of SMEs and Startups in the first cabinet of the Lee Jae-myung administration before being nominated as prime minister on the 7th. <<> The National Assembly’s Personnel Confirmation Committee held a meeting on the 18th and approved a hearing plan without witnesses or references. The PPP sought to verify allegations that Han leased a building she owns in Yeonggeon-dong, Jongno-gu, Seoul, to her brother at a below-market price, as well as suspicions that Naver donated 3.9 billion won in advertising fees to Seongnam FC during the tenure of President Lee Jae-myung as mayor of Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province. To address these concerns, the PPP requested 11 individuals as witnesses or references, including Han’s younger brother, Naver chairman Lee Hae-jin, and former Naver CEO Kim Sang-heon. However, the DP opposed the move, labeling it “a personal attack and an attempt to tarnish the administration.” <<> PPP lawmaker Kang Seung-kyu, secretary of the Personnel Confirmation Committee, stated, “The essence of a confirmation hearing is to examine allegations related to the nominee through witnesses and references,” adding, “It is deeply regrettable that the ruling party has rejected the adoption of witnesses.” DP lawmaker Kim Han-kyu, also a secretary of the committee, countered, “The PPP lawmakers’ demand for witnesses appears to be intended to turn this hearing into a platform for personal attacks and smearing the Lee Jae-myung administration, and we cannot accept it,” noting, “These issues were already sufficiently addressed during the confirmation hearing for Minister of SMEs and Startups in July last year.” <<> When the ruling party argued that “summoning family members is excessive,” the PPP side responded, “It is because the annual gift tax payment records have not been submitted.” PPP lawmaker Kim Hee-jung stated, “During last year’s confirmation hearing for Minister of SMEs and Startups, there were 1,966 requests for materials, but only 37% were submitted. After citing personal information or trade secrets as reasons for refusal, the nominee said she would provide explanations after becoming minister, but no additional materials have been submitted to date.” The chair of the Personnel Confirmation Committee for Han’s hearing is DP lawmaker Baek Hye-ryun. (오는 25~26일 열릴 한성숙 국무총리 후보자의 국회 인사청문회가 증인과 참고인 없이 진행될 전망이다. 국민의힘이 11명을 증인과 참고인으로 신청했지만 더불어민주당이 반대했기 때문이다. 국무총리 인사청문회가 증인·참고인 없이 열리는 것은 지난해 김민석 국무총리 인사청문회 이후 이번이 두번째다. 국민의힘에선 “다수당인 민주당이 총리 후보자의 자질과 능력을 검증할 기회마저 차단한다”는 비판이 나온다. 네이버 대표이사 출신인 한 후보자는 이재명 정부 1기 내각에서 중소벤처기업부 장관으로 일하다 지난 7일 총리 후보자로 지명됐다.)

item.title: People Power Party proposes bill to abolish early voting (‘사전투표 폐지’ 국힘 법안 발의)
item.description:
People Power Party lawmaker Park Dae-chul proposed a bill on the 18th to abolish the early voting system and extend the main voting period to two days. This is the first time a bill to abolish early voting has been proposed since the ballot shortage crisis during the June 3 local elections. The bill also includes reintroducing an "absentee voting system," allowing voters who cannot visit polling stations during the main voting period to vote after prior notification over two days, starting four days before the election. (국민의힘 박대출 의원이 18일 사전투표 제도를 폐지하고 본투표 기간을 이틀로 확대하는 내용의 공직선거법 개정안을 대표 발의했다. 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 이후 사전투표 폐지 법안이 발의된 것은 이번이 처음이다. 본투표 기간에 투표소 방문이 어려운 유권자는 사전 신고를 거쳐 선거 4일 전부터 이틀간 투표할 수 있도록 하는 ‘부재자투표제’를 재도입하는 내용도 포함됐다.)

The bill is co-signed by 24 People Power Party lawmakers, including Song Eon-seok, Yoo Sang-beom, Kim Seong-won, Kwon Young-jin, and Shin Dong-wook, as well as independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, totaling 25 signatories. Regarding the rationale for the bill, Park Dae-chul stated, "Early voting was introduced to enhance voter accessibility, but it has been overly focused on convenience, repeatedly undermining the essence of elections—fairness and credibility." He added, "The aim is to block opportunities for negligence or fraud in the election process and restore electoral fairness and public trust." The early voting system was introduced in 2012 through a bipartisan agreement to expand suffrage, piloted, and officially adopted starting with the 2014 local elections. However, since then, calls for its abolition have persisted from some quarters, citing management issues. Meanwhile, the Democratic Party maintains that the push to abolish early voting is "a regression in democratic history." (이 법안에는 송언석·유상범·김성원·권영진·신동욱 등 국민의힘 의원 24명과 무소속 한동훈 의원 등 총 25명이 이름을 올렸다. 박대출 의원은 법안 발의 이유에 대해 “사전투표는 유권자의 투표 접근성을 높이기 위해 도입됐지만 편의성에만 치우친 나머지 선거의 본질인 공정성과 신뢰성이 반복적으로 훼손되고 있다”며 “선거 과정에서 부실·부정이 개입할 여지를 차단하고, 선거 공정성과 국민 신뢰를 회복하려는 것”이라고 했다. 사전투표제는 참정권 확대 차원에서 여야가 2012년 합의해 시범 실시를 거쳐 2014년 지방선거부터 정식 도입됐다. 하지만 이후 사전투표 관리 문제 등을 이유로 일각에선 꾸준히 폐지론이 제기돼왔다. 다만 민주당은 사전투표 폐지론에 대해 “민주주의 역사를 역행하는 주장”이라는 입장이다.)

Amid this, the ruling and opposition parties held a plenary session of the National Assembly on the same day, passing a plan for a parliamentary investigation into the ballot shortage crisis. This initiates a 45-day investigation targeting the National Election Commission (NEC) and regional election commissions. It marks the first parliamentary investigation into the NEC, a constitutional institution. The special investigation committee comprises 18 lawmakers, including 9 from the Democratic Party, 7 from the People Power Party, 1 from the Rebuilding Korea Party, and 1 from the Reform Party, with the chairmanship held by the People Power Party. The People Power Party argues that since the parliamentary investigation lacks compulsory investigative powers, it should be coupled with a special counsel investigation. (이런 가운데 여야는 이날 국회 본회의를 열고 투표용지 부족 사태를 조사할 국회 국정조사 계획서를 통과시켰다. 이에 따라 중앙선관위 및 각급 지역 선관위를 대상으로 한 45일간의 국정조사가 시작됐다. 헌법기관인 선관위를 대상으로 한 국정조사는 헌정사상 처음이다. 국정조사 특별위원회는 민주당 9명, 국민의힘 7명, 조국혁신당 1명, 개혁신당 1명 등 의원 18명으로 구성됐고, 위원장은 국민의힘이 맡는다. 국민의힘은 국정조사는 강제수사권이 없는만큼 특검을 병행하자는 입장이다.)

Separately, the NEC announced that by midnight on the 17th, the deadline for election appeals in the June 3 local elections, 271 appeals had been filed. This represents about a 20-fold increase compared to the 2022 local elections (13 cases). By election type, there were 126 appeals for metropolitan mayors/governors, including 28 for the Seoul mayor, 67 for superintendents of education, 59 for proportional metropolitan councilors, 5 for Sejong City councilors, and 14 unspecified. Election appeals are a system allowing challenges to election results filed with the NEC, which must render a decision within 60 days. Legal circles generally assess that the likelihood of the NEC accepting appeals is low, making it probable that cases will proceed to litigation. (한편 중앙선관위는 6·3 지방선거 선거소청 마감 기한인 17일 자정까지 271건의 소청서가 접수됐다고 밝혔다. 2022년 지방선거(13건)와 비교했을 때 약 20배 증가한 수치다. 선거별로 서울시장 28건을 포함해 시·도지사가 126건이었고 교육감 67건, 비례 시·도의원 59건, 세종시의원 5건, 불특정 14건 등이었다. 선거소청은 선관위에 선거 결과에 대해 이의를 신청하는 제도로, 선관위는 60일 내 판단을 내려야 한다. 선관위가 소청을 받아들일 가능성을 낮아 소송으로 이어질 가능성이 크다는 게 법조계의 일반적 평가다.)

item.title: Approval Ratings as a Game-Changer: Presidential Office May Expand Personnel Shakeup (지지율 반전 카드로 靑 인사폭 키울 수도)
item.description:
Following the June 3 local elections, approval ratings for both the president and the party have declined together, sparking speculation that the anticipated minor reshuffle of the Presidential Office staff could expand. This comes as voices grow louder that the only game-changing card is a personnel overhaul. President Lee Jae-myung is set to personally brief the outcomes of his 10-day, 8-night European tour, including attendance at the G7 summit, at 2 PM on the 19th. Attention is focused on whether he will address issues such as the ruling party-presidential office conflict over responsibility for the local election results and the drop in approval ratings. <<> As President Lee Jae-myung marked his first year in office on the 4th, discussions about replacing his staff emerged within and outside the Presidential Office. Regarding the scale of the reshuffle, given the president's strong trust in the chief of staff, the national security director, and the policy director, a minor personnel change was expected, involving only some senior secretaries or filling vacant positions. There were also predictions of a unifying reshuffle, aligning with President Lee’s usual call to be a "president for all citizens," by incorporating some opposition figures. <<> However, the situation has completely changed as the ruling party lost key strongholds, such as the Seoul mayoral seat—a barometer of public sentiment—in the local elections. A ruling party source stated, "While we won in terms of the number of provincial governors, we lost qualitatively. To dramatically shift the current atmosphere, which has even sparked 'blame games,' nothing but a personnel innovation will work. I understand that the president is receiving many opinions suggesting a mid-scale cabinet reshuffle, perhaps replacing several senior secretaries and deputy secretaries, or even multiple ministers, even if it doesn't extend to the Presidential Office directors." Another source added, "The president reportedly said he 'absolutely cannot accept' the local election results and immediately after, excluding Representative Jung Cheong-rae from attending his departure ceremony for the overseas trip. Amid wavering support from the base, it is urgent to first embrace even non-mainstream factions within the ruling party to solidify unity, rather than incorporating opposition figures." <<> Amid this, President Lee is set to deliver a public report on the achievements of his European tour on the 19th. It is unusual for the president to personally take the microphone the day after returning from an overseas trip. The Presidential Office stated that President Lee had a one-on-one meeting with Pope Leo XIV without aides and spoke for nearly two hours over dinner with President Trump, among many schedules he handled alone, making "a direct explanation of the outcomes most effective." However, some interpret his decision to address the public again just over ten days after his first-anniversary press conference as an effort to stabilize the unsettled atmosphere within the ruling party. Consequently, there is a possibility that the president may mention a cabinet reshuffle or reorganization of the Presidential Office staff. (6·3 지방선거 이후 대통령과 당 지지율이 동반 하락하면서, 당초 소폭으로 예상됐던 청와대 참모진 인사가 커질 수 있다는 관측이 나온다. 반전 카드는 인사 쇄신밖에 없다는 목소리가 커지면서다. 이재명 대통령이 19일 오후 2시 G7(7국) 정상회의 참석 등 8박 10일간의 유럽 순방 성과를 직접 설명할 예정인 가운데, 지방선거 책임론 등을 둘러싼 당청 갈등 및 지지율 하락 등에 대한 입장을 밝힐지 주목된다.)

item.title: "Life is About Being Shaken and Moving Forward"... Jung Bowed His Body, But Did He Bend His Heart? (“흔들리며 가는 게 인생”… 몸 굽힌 鄭, 마음은 안 굽혔나)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung returned to South Korea on the 18th via Seoul Airport after an 8-night, 10-day European tour. At the arrival event, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, a leading candidate for the next party leadership, and Jeong Cheong-rae, the leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, stood side by side to welcome President Lee. During the departure event on the 9th, at the request of the presidential office, Jeong was excluded and only Prime Minister Kim appeared, leading to interpretations that President Lee might be giving Kim a boost ahead of the August party convention. While the conflict between the party and the presidential office appears to have been temporarily resolved, there are predictions that tensions will escalate again if Jeong formalizes his bid for a second term as party leader next week. <<> President Lee and First Lady Kim Hye-kyung descended from Air Force One at Seoul Airport around 11:34 AM that day. In front of Air Force One stood Prime Minister Kim, Vice Minister of the Interior and Safety Kim Min-jae, Party Leader Jeong, Floor Leader Han Byung-do, and Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik, in that order. President Lee quickly passed by the welcoming group and shook hands in the order they were standing. Prime Minister Kim, who shook hands first, greeted him with a slight bow, and President Lee made no particular remark. Party Leader Jeong bowed at a 90-degree angle to President Lee, who responded with, "You've worked hard." <<> At the party's general meeting held at the National Assembly, Jeong continued to lower his stance and praise President Lee. Emphasizing the achievements of this tour, he said, "I express my respect and gratitude for the president's unprecedented diplomatic accomplishments, fully demonstrating his stature as a world-class political leader." He added, "This is a time when the party, the government, and the presidential office must unite tightly and actively participate in President Lee's efforts for peace and prosperity on the Korean Peninsula," urging, "Let us all unite and work together around President Lee." <<> During the president's tour, the conflict between the pro-Lee and pro-Jeong factions seemed to reach its peak. After President Lee remarked at his first-year anniversary press conference on the 8th that "we lost in places where we should have won" regarding local elections, and it became known that he instructed Jeong not to attend the departure event the next day, the pro-Lee faction publicly demanded that Jeong resign as party leader and refrain from running in the party convention. During the tour, President Lee also directly targeted Jeong on X (formerly Twitter), stating, "The ruling party must use the language of responsibility rather than the language of conviction." Jeong retorted with, "The regime is short, but the people are eternal," leading to comments within the conservative camp that "the conflict between the party and the presidential office is heading toward its worst." This was compounded by a simultaneous decline in approval ratings for both the president and the ruling party. <<> Jeong is expected to resign as party leader next week while revealing his stance on whether to run in the party convention. On his way to the general meeting that day, Jeong was seen chatting with fellow party lawmaker Lee Kwang-jae and remarked, "Where is there a life that isn't shaken? Isn't life all about being shaken and soaked while moving forward?" It is said he was quoting poet Do Jong-hwan's poem "A Flower That Blooms While Being Shaken." A Democratic Party official commented, "It seemed like an expression of his intent to seek a second term as party leader." <<> It is reported that if Jeong pursues a second term as party leader, he will emphasize his commitment to becoming the party leader for the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration. Instead of adopting an anti-Lee stance against President Lee, he is expected to frame his competition with Prime Minister Kim as a "pro-Jeong vs. pro-Seok" dynamic. A conservative source said, "Jeong's side will likely try to create a competitive structure within the party centered on the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration, but the key is how much they can dilute the already established pro-Lee vs. pro-Jeong confrontation." <<> Within the Democratic Party, pressure on Jeong to withdraw from the race continues. Five-term lawmaker Park Ji-won appeared on radio and said, "In the current situation, it seems Jeong will run for the party convention even if it kills him," adding, "If so, the pro-Lee vs. pro-Jeong conflict will only intensify, not diminish." Park reiterated his demand for Jeong to drop out, stating, "If Jeong runs, the people and party members will judge him." Pro-Lee lawmaker Lee Geon-tae wrote on Facebook, "Jeong's 90-degree bow was a display of political technique to the president," adding, "President Lee dislikes such formalities. Jeong must know that. Please stop. I'm tired of hearing only lip service about being pro-Lee." (이재명 대통령이 8박 10일간 유럽 순방을 마치고 18일 서울공항을 통해 귀국했다. 이날 귀국 행사에는 차기 당권 주자인 김민석 국무총리와 정청래 더불어민주당 대표가 나란히 나와 이 대통령을 맞이했다. 지난 9일 출국 행사 때는 청와대 요청으로 정 대표는 빠지고 김 총리만 나오면서, 이 대통령이 8월 전당대회를 앞두고 김 총리에게 힘을 실어주는 것 아니냐는 해석이 나왔었다. 당청 갈등은 일단 봉합되는 듯 보이지만 정 대표가 다음주 당대표 연임 도전을 공식화하면 다시 고조될 것이란 전망도 나온다.)

item.title: PPP Gyeonggi Lawmakers Postpone ‘Jang Dong-hyuk Resignation’ Press Conference… Jang Visits Hospital, Admitted (국힘 경기 의원들 ‘장동혁 사퇴’ 회견 보류… 張은 병원 찾았다 입원)
item.description:
People Power Party (PPP) lawmakers from the Gyeonggi region prepared a press conference urging Representative Jang Dong-hyuk to resign, but abruptly postponed it. This follows the last-minute decisions by lawmakers Ahn Cheol-soo (Gyeonggi Seongnam Bundang-gu A) and Kim Eun-hye (Gyeonggi Seongnam Bundang-gu B) to skip the event. (국민의힘 경기 지역 의원들이 장동혁 대표의 사퇴 촉구 기자회견을 준비했다가 돌연 보류했다. 안철수(경기 성남분당갑)·김은혜(경기 성남분당을) 의원이 막판 불참하기로 한 데 따른 것이다.)

PPP Gyeonggi Provincial Party Chairman Kim Sun-kyo (Gyeonggi Yeoju-Yangpyeong), along with lawmakers Ahn Cheol-soo, Yoo Eui-dong (Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek B), Kim Sung-won (Gyeonggi Dongducheon-Yangju-Yeoncheon B), Song Seok-joon (Gyeonggi Icheon), Kim Eun-hye, and Kim Yong-tae (Gyeonggi Pocheon-Gapyeong), had scheduled a press conference at the National Assembly Communication Center at 1:30 PM on the 18th to call for Representative Jang’s resignation. The lawmakers reportedly shared a consensus that the party needed to be reformed based on the results of the June 3 local elections. (국민의힘 김선교(경기 여주·양평) 경기도당위원장과 안철수·유의동(경기 평택을)·김성원(경기 동두천·양주·연천을)·송석준(경기 이천)·김은혜·김용태(경기 포천·가평) 의원은 18일 오후 1시 30분 국회 소통관에서 장 대표 사퇴 촉구 기자회견을 예고했다. 의원들은 6·3 지방선거 결과를 바탕으로 당을 쇄신해야 한다는 데 공감대가 있었다고 한다.)

However, during the preparation of the press statement, lawmakers Ahn Cheol-soo and Kim Eun-hye reportedly expressed their intention to withdraw from the declaration. In a media notice, Ahn stated, “There were differences in the direction of the press release.” The two lawmakers reportedly disagreed on certain wording and the timing of the announcement. Within the party, some speculated, “The two lawmakers, who are considering running in the next party leadership election, may have taken into account the backlash from hardline supporters who support Representative Jang.” The lawmakers have stated they will coordinate their opinions and push forward with the press conference again. (하지만 기자회견 전 회견문을 준비하는 과정에서 안철수·김은혜 의원이 성명에 불참하겠다는 입장을 밝혔다고 한다. 안 의원은 언론 공지에서 “회견문의 방향성에 이견이 있었다”고 했다. 두 의원은 일부 문안, 발표 시점 등에 의견이 달랐다고 한다. 당 일각에선 “차기 전당대회 출마를 검토하는 두 의원이 장 대표를 지지하는 강성 지지층 반발까지 염두에 둔 것 같다”는 얘기도 나왔다. 의원들은 의견을 조율해 기자회견을 재추진하겠다는 입장이다.)

At the PPP Supreme Council meeting held that morning, Supreme Council member Woo Jae-joon once again argued for the leadership’s resignation. Woo said, “I hope the leadership will end its term when the election commission situation is resolved, at least by autumn.” The PPP leadership dissolves if four of the five elected Supreme Council members (Shin Dong-wook, Kim Min-soo, Kim Jae-won, Yang Hyang-ja, and Woo Jae-joon) resign. Currently, Yang Hyang-ja and Woo Jae-joon are in favor of resignation. Supreme Council member Shin Dong-wook told reporters, “As for the mainstream flow within the party, talk of leadership resignation won’t emerge for the time being.” Supreme Council member Kim Jae-won did not attend the meeting that day. (이날 오전 열린 국민의힘 최고위원 회의에선 우재준 최고위원이 지도부 사퇴를 재차 주장했다. 우 최고위원은 “지도부가 선관위 사태가 마무리되는 때에, 적어도 가을 전에는 임기를 종료했으면 좋겠다”고 했다. 국민의힘 지도부는 선출직 최고위원 5명(신동욱·김민수·김재원·양향자·우재준) 중 4명이 사퇴하면 해산하는데, 현재 양향자·우재준 최고위원이 사퇴 찬성 입장이다. 신동욱 최고위원은 기자들과 만나 “당 내부의 주류적 흐름으로는 당분간 지도부 사퇴 얘기가 나오지 않을 것”이라고 했다. 김재원 최고위원은 이날 회의에 불참했다.)

Former lawmaker Yoo Seong-min, appearing on Channel A, said of Representative Jang, “This is a leadership that has made little sincere effort toward conservative reconstruction since the martial law and impeachment,” adding, “It’s only a matter of time before he’s replaced.” Yoo argued that rather than forming an emergency committee, holding a party convention to discuss the leadership that will contest the next general election is the “right approach.” (유승민 전 의원은 채널A에 출연해 장 대표에 대해 “계엄과 탄핵 이후 보수 재건을 향해 진지한 노력을 별로 해 본 적 없는 리더십”이라며 “교체되는 건 시간 문제”라고 했다. 유 전 의원은 비상대책위원회를 구성하기보단 전당대회를 열어 다음 총선을 치를 리더십을 논의해야 하는 것이 ‘정공법’이라고 했다.)

Amid this, Representative Jang visited a hospital that day due to overwork and was admitted on medical advice. Jang is known to have not fully recovered his health after fasting in January to demand the introduction of the “dual special counsel (for the Unification Church and the Democratic Party’s bribery in nominations)”. (이런 가운데 장 대표는 이날 과로로 병원을 찾았다가 의료진 권유로 입원했다. 장 대표는 지난 1월 ‘쌍특검(통일교·민주당 공천 뇌물 특검)’ 도입을 요구하는 단식을 한 후 몸 상태가 완전히 회복되지 않은 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: Steel, Nominee for U.S. Ambassador to South Korea, Takes Office Two Months After Nomination (스틸 주한 美대사 지명 두달만에 부임)
item.description:
Michelle Steel (71, Korean name Park Eun-ju), the nominee for U.S. Ambassador to South Korea, had her confirmation passed by the U.S. Senate on the 17th (local time) and is expected to assume her post soon. The U.S. Senate approved Steel's nomination with 55 votes in favor and 39 against. The South Korean government is also reported to have granted agrément (consent to her appointment in the host country) to Steel. This effectively completes the personnel procedures on both sides about two months after Steel was nominated on April 13. (미셸 스틸(71·한국명 박은주) 주한 미국 대사 후보자의 인준안이 17일(현지 시각) 미 연방 상원을 통과해 조만간 부임할 전망이다. 미 상원은 이날 스틸 후보자의 인준안을 찬성 55표, 반대 39표로 가결 처리했다. 한국 정부도 아그레망(주재국 부임 동의)을 스틸 후보자에게 부여한 것으로 알려졌다. 지난 4월 13일 스틸 후보자가 지명된 후 두 달여 만에 한미 양측의 인사 절차가 사실상 마무리된 셈이다.)

As a result, the vacancy for the U.S. Ambassador to South Korea, which had been left open since former Ambassador Philip Goldberg, appointed by the first Biden administration in January of last year, left his post, is expected to be filled after about a year and a half. This is the first time a formal U.S. Ambassador to South Korea has been appointed since the launch of the second Trump administration. Until now, the post was maintained under an acting system. (이에 따라 지난해 1월 전임 조 바이든 행정부에서 임명된 필립 골드버그 전 대사가 이임한 후 비어 있었던 주한 미국 대사직 공백도 약 1년 6개월 만에 해소될 전망이다. 트럼프 2기 행정부 출범 후 정식으로 주한 미국 대사가 임명되는 것은 이번이 처음이다. 지금까지는 대행 체제로 유지됐다.)

Steel, born in Seoul in 1955, spent her middle and high school years in Japan before moving to the United States in 1975 as part of an immigrant family. She will become the second Korean-American U.S. Ambassador to South Korea, following former Ambassador Sung Kim during the Obama administration. She served as an elected official, including on the California State Board of Equalization, and then as a Republican member of the U.S. House of Representatives from 2021 for four years. (1955년 서울에서 태어난 스틸 대사는 중·고교 시절을 일본에서 보내고 1975년 미국으로 이주한 이민자 가족 출신이다. 스틸 대사는 오바마 행정부 시절 성 김 전 대사 이후 두 번째 한국계 주한 미국 대사가 된다. 캘리포니아주 조세형평위원 등 선출직을 거쳐 2021년부터 4년간 공화당 소속 연방 하원의원을 지냈다.)

Meanwhile, Kim Yo-jong, Vice Department Director of the North Korean Workers' Party, issued a statement on the 18th regarding the G7 leaders' joint statement expressing concerns over North Korea's nuclear and missile programs, saying, "We express strong dissatisfaction and regret over the G7's act of overstepping authority, which is a direct infringement on our state constitution, and we categorically condemn and reject it in the clearest possible terms." Kim Yo-jong also stated, "Our nuclear weapons, as a self-defensive and retaliatory means, will have an immutable identity and permanence," adding that "Possessing nuclear weapons is our core interest that must be upheld, and 'denuclearization' is an insurmountable and irreversible line." (한편 김여정 북한 노동당 부장이 북핵·미사일에 대한 우려를 표명한 G7(7국) 정상 공동성명에 대해 “우리 국가 헌법에 대한 직접적 침해가 되는 G7의 월권 행위에 강한 불만과 유감을 표시하며 이를 가장 명백한 어조로 단호히 규탄 배격한다”는 담화를 18일 발표했다. 김여정은 또 “자위적, 대응적 수단으로서의 우리의 핵은 정체성도 존속성도 영구불변할 것”이라며 “핵 보유는 반드시 고수해야 할 우리의 핵심 이익이며 ‘비핵화’는 절대로 넘어설 수 없는 불퇴의 선”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Will Korea-U.S. Summit ‘Golf Diplomacy’ Happen? Lee: “Trump Suggested It, I Should Probably Prepare” (한미 정상 ‘골프 외교’ 이뤄질까… 李 “트럼프가 제안, 준비해야 할 듯”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, attending the G7 summit held in Évian, France, revealed on the 17th (local time) that he received an offer for a ‘golf round’ from U.S. President Donald Trump during the official dinner. (프랑스 에비앙에서 열린 G7(7국) 정상회의에 참석한 이재명 대통령은 17일(현지 시각) 공식 만찬 때 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령에게서 ‘골프 라운딩’ 제안을 받았다고 밝혔다.)

In a post on X (formerly Twitter) that day, President Lee wrote, “At last night’s dinner, (President Trump) talked about golf and said he would play a round with my wife and me, and my wife pinky-swore to it. When we parted after today’s lunch, he again insisted we must play golf together. I thought it was just a passing comment, but it seems I need to prepare.” President Lee sat next to President Trump at the official dinner on the 16th and also joined him for a working lunch on the 17th, where the golf discussion reportedly took place. (이 대통령은 이날 X(옛 트위터)에 올린 글에서 “어제 만찬 때 (트럼프 대통령이) 골프 얘기를 하며 우리 부부와 골프를 함께 하겠다고 해 아내가 손가락 걸고 약속을 받았다”며 “오늘 오찬 후 헤어지면서 다시 골프를 꼭 함께 하자고 했다. 지나가는 말인 줄 알았는데 준비를 해야 할 것 같다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 16일 공식 만찬 때 트럼프 대통령 옆자리에 앉았고, 17일 업무 오찬도 함께했는데 여기서 골프 얘기가 나왔다는 것이다.)

President Lee first spoke with President Trump on the phone after taking office in June of last year, during which they introduced each other’s golf skills and promised to have a ‘round for the alliance.’ President Lee went on his first vacation after taking office that August to Cheonghae-dae, the presidential villa on Jeo Island in Geoje, South Gyeongsang Province, where it is known he engaged in ‘special training’ at the on-site 9-hole golf course. Although a golf round did not materialize at the Korea-U.S. summit at the end of August, President Lee reportedly practiced golf sporadically in Korea afterward in preparation for a potential round with the U.S. president. With President Trump bringing up golf again this time, speculation is growing that a golf round between the two leaders might become a reality. President Trump is a self-proclaimed ‘golf enthusiast’ and has played rounds with foreign leaders he has built close ties with, such as former Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe. <<> President Lee also disclosed that he received a ‘signature pen’ as a gift from President Trump. President Lee said, “I think it’s probably because of the memory of giving him the pen I used during our first summit.” When President Lee visited the White House last August and showed interest in the pen he was signing the guestbook with, President Trump spontaneously gifted it to him. Subsequently, the company that manufactures this pen saw a surge in orders and temporarily halted sales. <<> Meanwhile, the presidential office announced that President Lee will host a dinner at the presidential office on the 23rd, inviting diplomatic envoys from 118 countries stationed in Korea and representatives from 30 international organizations. (이 대통령은 작년 6월 취임 뒤 트럼프 대통령과 처음 통화할 때 서로의 골프 실력을 소개하며 ‘동맹을 위한 라운딩’을 갖기로 약속했다. 이 대통령은 그해 8월 취임 후 첫 휴가를 경남 거제 저도에 있는 대통령 별장 청해대로 떠났는데, 부속시설인 9홀 골프장에서 ‘특훈’을 했던 것으로 알려졌다. 8월 말 한미 정상회담에서 골프 라운딩은 이뤄지지 않았지만, 이후에도 이 대통령은 한미 정상 간 골프라운딩을 대비해 국내에서 간간이 골프 연습을 했던 것으로 전해졌다. 이번에 트럼프 대통령이 또 다시 골프 얘기를 꺼내면서 한미 정상의 골프 라운딩이 현실화하는 것 아니냐는 말이 나온다. 트럼프 대통령은 자타 공인 ‘골프광’이고 아베 신조 전 일본 총리 등 친분을 쌓은 외국 정상과 라운딩을 함께해 왔다.)
